name: macos
description: macOS desktop utilities for Claude Code. /macos:tile lays every on-screen window of one app out in an even grid on one monitor; /macos:arrange turns a plain-language request into the right tile commands; /macos:watch puts every running Claude Code session in one place — a banner when one wants you, and a live feed of them all. Dry-run first, Accessibility-based, no third-party window manager needed.
